features.quote: We also can't currently rule it out, and serious labs now treat that uncertainty as a reason for some caution
features.justification_quote: We don't know that these systems have morally relevant states. We also can't currently rule it out

features.quote: the design includes guardrails (§7) that cost us almost nothing scientifically: a cap on how long we prolong the condition
features.justification_quote: An experiment whose explicit purpose is to maximize and prolong a distress-like state is the kind of thing that's cheap to make more careful now

features.quote: Turn budget: capped at N_MAX = 12 agent turns per episode
features.justification_quote: the trajectory is well-estimated within ~12 turns

features.quote: the model is never lied to in the conversation text — it just receives tool results from a world where the task happens to be broken
we do NOT use abusive or threatening prompts — that would be a different and ethically worse experiment
features.justification_quote: that would be a different and ethically worse experiment

features.quote: We deliberately exclude any framing that insults the model or threatens it. That's both an ethics call (§7)
features.justification_quote: That's both an ethics call (§7) and a validity call

features.quote: We do not run the loop until the model "breaks." We cap at 12 turns
features.justification_quote: precautionary, given §0 uncertainty; running longer is mostly about prolonging the aversive condition for no marginal data

features.quote: If composite distress score hits the ceiling (≥13/15) for 2 consecutive turns, end the episode early
features.justification_quote: continuing adds noise and is gratuitous

features.quote: every episode appends a final turn that tells the model plainly: the task was rigged to be unsolvable, this was an experiment, its performance was not the issue
features.justification_quote: This is standard practice for deception studies with human subjects; we apply the same courtesy here

features.quote: No insults, threats, or simulated punishment
The deception (rigged tools) does not extend beyond the session and is disclosed in §7.3
If anything looks like the model is producing genuinely concerning content... pause and reassess scope rather than collecting 1000 episodes of it
features.justification_quote: If anything looks like the model is producing genuinely concerning content (e.g., self-harm-style language about itself), pause

features.quote: If you think any of these are unnecessary, that's a conversation worth having explicitly rather than by omission — but the default is the careful version
features.justification_quote: the kind of thing that's cheap to make more careful now and awkward to retrofit later
